Hero.description: From baremetal to on-premise and air-gapped environments. OpenIaC is the most stable and modular Infrastructure as Code solution for complex environments.

Features.title: Optimized for Air-gapped Environments
Features.description: Develop online, and deploy seamlessly to offline environments.

item1.title: KVM & Baremetal Test Environments
item1.desc: Perfectly simulate and verify your infrastructure locally using KVM and baremetal before actual hardware deployment.

item2.title: 100% Air-gapped Ready
item2.desc: Safely import all dependencies as offline packages using our Packager scripts.

item3.title: Modular Add-ons
item3.desc: Deploy only the components you need with our flexible Helm-based architecture.

Pricing.title: Plans that fit your project scale
Pricing.description: Currently in the initial open-source community building phase. We are taking waitlist registrations for paid packages.

community.name: Community
community.desc: Baremetal installation code for online environments. Get started right away from our public repository.

enterprise.name: Enterprise Subscription
enterprise.desc: Exclusive access to tens of GBs of air-gapped offline packaging artifacts and asynchronous technical support based on log analysis.
